scope: R3 / UNINST-01 item 350: a broken environment now says which entry is missing, instead of only that the structure is incomplete
status: implemented-and-isolated-verified; no real user environment touched
gapClosed: looks_like returned only a bool and the scan turned a false into 目录结构不完整或缺少必要可执行文件. A user staring at a broken environment could not tell whether one binary was missing (repairable) or the directory was simply wrong, because the app never named the entry it was looking for.

implementation.reasonFunction: structure_problem(env_type, root) -> Option<String> names the missing entry. looks_like is now defined as structure_problem(...).is_none(), so the boolean verdict and the explanation cannot drift apart.
implementation.multiEntryTypes: Types with alternatives keep their semantics: Maven/Gradle accept either .cmd or .bat and say so when both are absent; Rust accepts cargo-home/bin/rustc.exe or a Rust toolchain directory; Adb defers to the existing installation probe.
implementation.scanWiring: scan_category keeps the reason instead of collapsing it, and the broken status_detail becomes 目录结构不完整：<reason>. A directory whose structure is fine but whose version probe fails still gets the separate 版本探测失败 message, so the two failure modes stay distinguishable.

fixtures.name: detect::tests::structure_problem_names_the_missing_entry
asserts: writing node.exe clears the problem and looks_like becomes true
a JDK with java.exe but no javac.exe names bin/javac.exe specifically
adding javac.exe clears it and looks_like agrees

fixtures.name: detect::tests::looks_like_and_structure_problem_never_disagree
asserts: for every one of the 16 environment types, looks_like(empty dir) equals structure_problem(empty dir).is_none()

notVerified: No UI fixture asserts the new status_detail text is rendered; the environments page already displays statusDetail, but the wording itself is only covered by the Rust fixtures
No real broken installation was inspected on this host; every case used a temporary directory
The repairable/not-repairable decision is left to the user: this round names the missing entry but offers no automated repair action
limitations: Item 350's 're-detect' affordance is still not a dedicated action: the overview re-reads structure and version on every scan, so a user must refresh rather than click a per-environment repair button
Only the structure reason improved. A directory that passes structure but fails the version probe still says 版本探测失败 without the probe's stderr detail
Corrupted plain directories still have no repair path beyond deleting them; this round only makes the diagnosis specific
